crossRefs.note: They said to the messengers who came, “Tell the men of Jabesh Gilead, ‘Tomorrow, by the time the sun is hot, you will…
Do you see a man skilled in his work? He will serve kings. He won’t serve obscure men.
Rescue those who are being led away to death! Indeed, hold back those who are staggering to the slaughter!
If you say, “Behold, we didn’t know this,” doesn’t he who weighs the hearts consider it? He who keeps your soul…
Whatever your hand finds to do, do it with your might; for there is no work, nor plan, nor knowledge, nor wisdom, in…
You therefore must endure hardship as a good soldier of Christ Jesus.
preach the word; be urgent in season and out of season; reprove, rebuke, and exhort with all patience and teaching.

people.name: Gilgal
people.line: A significant site during Israel's early history in Canaan.

people.name: Joshua
people.line: Moses' assistant who led Israel into Canaan

translations.web: Joshua therefore came to them suddenly. He marched from Gilgal all night.
translations.bsb: After marching all night from Gilgal, Joshua caught them by surprise.
translations.kjv: Joshua therefore came unto them suddenly, and went up from Gilgal all night.
translations.asv: Joshua therefore came upon them suddenly; for he went up from Gilgal all the night.
